html:
Agents, below you will find the details about patch 1.9.0
 


▣ 1 New Character Added
 
Hulk (Amadeus Cho) just joined the fight for the future!
 

 
Due to the new Hero, new achievements and new team bonuses have been added.
 
 
 
 
▣ 5 New Uniforms
 
 5 New Uniforms been added for Angela, Hulk, Loki, Drax, and Rocket Raccoon.
 

* You will be able to check new uniforms in Marvel Universe and Uniform Room.
* New uniforms will be available for a discounted price during a certain period.
 
▣ New 6★ Skills
 
 Hulk, Red Hulk, Star-Lord, Hulkbuster, Drax, and Captain Marvel now have their 6 Star Skills.
 
 
 
 1. Hulk(including Uniforms): Hulk Slam.
 2. Red Hulk: Avalanche Smash.
 3. Hulkbuster: Barrage Strike.
 4. Star-Lord: Come and Get it.
 5. Drax: Blade Retribution.
 6. Captain Marvel: Radiant Form.
 
▣ Character Revamp
 
Some Character revamped to suppress enemies more effectively.
 

 
 1. Hulk(including Uniforms)
  - Melee and Range Attack animation has been added on his normal attack.
  - "Hulk Smash" - Skill Animations improved.
 
 2. Red Hulk
  - "Burning Fury" – Increased hits and new animation added.
- "Hulk Blast" – Skill animations improved.
 - "Blazing Leap" – Skill animations improved.
 
 3. Star-Lord
  - "Gravity Granade" – Skill Animation time improved.
  - "Hadron Enforcer" – Skill Animation time improved.
  - "Hadron Enforcer " – Skill now tracks the enemy.
 
 4. Hulkbuster
  - "Repulsor Smash ", "Jet-Assisted Takedown" –Skill Animation improved, Damage Increased.
  - "Repulsor Smash", " Jet-Assisted Takedown" – Skill Cooldown Time Decreased.
  - "Hydraulic Boom" – Skill Cooldown Time Increased, Damage Increased.
  - "Arc Reactor Burst" – Damage Increased.
 
 5. Drax
  - New Normal Attack Animation added.
  - "Dagger Fall" – Skill Animation improved, Damage Increased.
  - "Takedown" – Skill Animation Quicken, Last attack of the skill’s range has been broadened, Damage Increased.
  - "Obliterate" – Powerful Skill Animation, Damage Increased.
 
 6. Silk
  - "Web Rebound" – She will not use this skill if she is a Striker.
 
 7. Warwolf
  - He hits enemies more effectively if enemies placed some distance away.
 
 8. Spider-Man: All-New, All-Different
  - "Web Shot" – the one who was targeted and enemies near the target will get webbed.
 
 9. Ant-Man(including Uniforms)
- "Pym Discs" – Area of Effect has been broadened.
 
 10. Ultron(including Uniforms)
  - Ultron's Minion's HP boosted.
 
 11. Spider-Gwen
  - All Skill's Animation improved.
  - "What Goes Up...", "One-Two Kick" – Skill Cooldown Time Decreased.
 
 12. Ghost Rider(including Uniforms)
   - "Highway to Hell", "Hellfire", "Damnation Chains" – It hits the enemies more effectively.
   - "Penance Stare" – If there is no enemies near Ghost Rider, he stop use the skill instead keep using until the skill animation finished.
 
 13. Spider-Man(including Uniforms)
   - "Web Swing Kick" – It hits the enemies more effectively.
 
 14. Angela(including Uniforms)
   - "Sword Blow", "Avenging Angel" – It hits the enemies more effectively.
 
15. Daisy Johnson(including Uniforms)
   - "A Real Stunner", "Vibrations" – Skill Cooldown Time Error has been fixed.
 
▣ Lobby and Hero Menu Improved
 
 Lobby and Hero Section has been improved to check things more easily.
 
 1. Lobby Improvement.
 
 

 
 2. Team Menu Improvement.

 
 
▣ 3 New Missions in Villain Siege
 
 1. New Missions of Ultron, Loki, and Yellow Jacket have been added.
 

 
2. Recommended Hero System Added
 If you clear Villain Siege Missions with Recommended Hero(es), you will be awarded with up to 3 Random rewards.
 


 
※Recommended Heroes will be changed everyday.
 
 
 
▣ Team-Up Play Improvement
 
 For your best gaming experience, Team-Up Play system improved.
 
 1. Leadership Skill & Team Bonus Effect.
  Now your selected character can use their Leadership Skill (if your character is the Leader) and/or Team Bonus Effects in Team-Up Play.

 
 2. Ban System Improvement
  If your character does not move and/or Attack enemy, you will be automatically kicked out from Team-Up play.
※ AI will take the control of kicked out character.
 
 ▣ Alliance Battle Improvement
 
 1. Time Limit Added.
  For your convenience, time limit for alliance battle has been added.
 

※ When the continue window shows up, time will not consumed.
※ If you press Home button during alliance battle, time will still run, so be careful!
 
 ▣ Missions Improvement
 
For your best gaming experience, some stages have been improved.
 
 1. Daily Mission Improvement.
  - New Daily Mission for Lv.60 characters has been added.
  - ISO-8 Drop rate has been increased.
 
 2. Story Mission Chapter 9&10 Improvement.
  - Chapter 9&10 also has been changed that you may fight against more enemies at one time.
 
 3. Cleared Icon Added
  - If you clear the stage that has daily limit, it will be checked with green mark on it.
 
   
 
 4. Tag Notification Added
  - A new system has been added which shows when characters are low and should be tagged in.

 5. Auto-Play Improvement
  - Special Missions Chapter Completion 100% Repeat/Stop function has been moved out from the option.
    ※ If you reach at 100% in Special Missions, Auto-Repeat stops.
  - You can control Frame Rate during Auto-Play.
 
 
▣ Selling items and Using Exp Chips Improvement
 
 For your convenience, the UI for selling items and using EXP chips has been improved.
 
 1. Control Bar for selling items has been added
   - You may now easily sell items in large quantities with the new Control Bar!
  
 
 
 2. Max button added in Exp Chips window
  - You may use many EXP chips all at once with MAX button!
 
 
 
 
▣ Other Improvements
 
1. Assemble Points are now available to send in-game friends only.
2. Biometrics Selector from Free Hero Chest in Shop will remain in your mail for 24 Hours.
  - Free Hero Chest only, If you purchase the Hero Chest with Crystals, Selector still remains in your mail for unlimited time
  - Previous selectors in your mail will still remain in your mail as unlimited items
3. Disconnecting from Chat Servers has been stabilized.
4. Chatting Window still remains after you've finish the Mission.
5. Warp Device will only notify you once after all the missions have been completed.
6. Antimatter Generator will only notify you once after the generator reaches it to maximum point to collect Antimatter.
7. Daily Achievement rewards improved

 
 
 8. When you try to equip special gear at the first time, you will get a notice saying it is not available to take off.
 9. Fixed an issue of Recovery Rate of She-Hulk in Uniform.
10. Fixed an issue of Lash(include Uniform)'s skill "Undeserving" that did not activate correctly.
11. Fixed an issue with friend's codename that displays in wrong position in team up when they have Iron Man with Secret Wars:2099 Uniform.
12. Fixed an issue with Wasp's skill "Encouragement" buff that does not disappear after tagging.
13. Certain character's pulling skills is now more effective against bosses.
- Ghost Rider(Penance Stare), Star-Lord(Gravity Grenade), Lincoln(Magnetic Repulsion), Singularity(Space Fold), Silk(The Yo-Yo), Spider-Gwen(The Blender), Venom(Lethal Symbiosis), Lash(Undeserving)
14. If you don't have enough space in your inventory, it is now impossible to receive items from any mail nor enter missions until there is space in your inventory. 
15. Token Shop item list refreshed.
 1) Honor Token Shop
    Red Hulk Biometric has been replaced to Thor Biometric.

 
 2) Chaos Token Shop
   Hulk and Hulkbuster Biometric have been replaced with Ant-Man and Black Panther.

16. You can immediately refresh the period of Tony Stark's Stash when you have less than 3 days remaining.
17. Fixed an issue with ISO-8 Set Effect still remains after tagging.
18. If you press attack button in stages, it will automatically find enemies to fight.
19. You will be able to check New/Returned Agent Rewards in the Lobby.
20. Some Heroes' Uniforms with skill display errors have been fixed.
21. Material tapping error that forced you to move to the mission without scrolling fixed
22. Camera in timeline battle now stabilized
23. Villain Siege navigation problems resolved.
24. Certain Heroes Gear Option errors have been fixed, this problem only affected certain agents.
25. Fixed an issue where if you did not login within 3 days or more, your Villain Siege cleared stages go back to stage 1 
26. In game font has been changed.
